rdfs:label: Post
rdfs:comment: A position within an organization that may be filled by an Agent — independent of who currently holds it.
notes: A Post is a *seat* (e.g. "CTO of ACME"); the Agent who fills it changes over time. Compare with `org:Membership` (a time-bound link between Agent, Organization, and Role) and `org:Role` (the abstract role itself). Use Post when the position has an identity independent of its current holder. Attach the role with `org:role` (http://www.w3.org/ns/org#role). Note that `urn:solid:role` is vcard:role (a job-title string), not org:role.

examples.title: A named position in an organization

history.note: Example uses org:role instead of urn:solid:role (vcard:role); seeAlso swaps role for heldBy/postIn/org:role; notes explain role vs org:role.
